title: evals/replay/run.ts runs live arm sessions through the host-wide eval slot
body:
Evidence 2026-11-16: node evals/replay/run.ts prints 'live sessions need the session driver (lane run); use --dry'; #1242 added evals/session-slot.ts but replay has no live call site. S7 screen of arm A (t-1p7dmw9) needs it.
Outcome: node evals/replay/run.ts --screen runs arm A sessions on the units under evals/units with at most KRN_EVAL_MAX_SESSIONS concurrent claude sessions and writes graded rows
Proof: a test with a stub claude runs the screen on 2 units and asserts 2 graded rows and peak concurrency <= the cap
